# Buildwise Studios — Hong Kong Legal Agent Staffing

> We staff workflow agents into Hong Kong legal teams — contract triage, first-pass review, and deadline tracking inside your environment and playbooks. Each agent is a hire, not a project.

Buildwise Studios places legal workflow agents inside Hong Kong law firms, in-house teams, and businesses with growing legal workload. Every output is a draft for lawyer review — agents do the first pass; qualified lawyers verify and decide. Same model as every vertical: audit the workflow, pilot one agent with measured baselines, convert to monthly retainer when KPIs hit.
